title: Week 4: Demo day
summary: The finale. Catch up on anything you missed, give your robot a job and a new personality for the show, then demo it to guests and vote for the best robots.
detail: The first half is open studio: helpers have kits for every stage so anyone who missed a week can catch up, and everyone else polishes their robot and teaches it a trick for the demo. The second half is demo day: each robot gets a couple of minutes with a guest, we film them, and the room votes.
outcome: A finished robot with a job and a personality of your own, shown off to a live audience, and a clip of it.
artifact: A demo-ready talking robot and a video of it in front of guests.
prereqs: Your laptop, for the Pi's remote link.

slides.title: Week 4: Demo day
bullets: It talks, it moves, it turns its head, it runs on its own.
First: catch up, polish, and teach it a new trick.

slides.title: What each robot needs this week
bullets: ☐ Your robot, with its Pi, speakerphone and power bank, fully charged
Bring: your laptop and your Deepgram key
slides.note: Helper table: catch-up kits for every stage (ready Week 1 robots, neck kits, ready Pis), spare charged power banks, spare cables. For the demo: a phone tripod, a plain backdrop, voting cards. Invite guests for the second half.

slides.title: Catch up or polish
bullets: Missed a week? Helpers have a kit for every stage.
Fix anything wobbly, buzzing or slow.
Decorate it. It's going on stage.

slides.title: Teach it a new trick
bullets: Give it a job for the demo: tour guide, game-show host, fortune teller.
Rewrite its personality to fit. Keep replies short.
Use its skills: the weather, the calendar, looking around.
Tune Patience so it doesn't talk over guests.
Rehearse with a partner playing a guest.
slides.note: Walk the room and push people to change one thing at a time and test again.

slides.title: Show it off
bullets: Each robot gets two minutes with a guest.
Film it and share it with #RobotLunchLab.
Votes: best personality, best voice, best build.

slides.title: Four weeks, one robot
bullets: A box that listens, thinks, talks, moves and runs on its own.
Thank you for building with us.
slides.note: Ask what people would add next. Collect ideas for the next series.

troubleshooting: Behind? Ask a helper for the kit for the stage you're on: you can demo at any stage.
It talks over guests: raise Patience a little.
The battery dies mid-demo: helpers have charged spares.
